authorization: Maintainer: Keep and Optimize for 1 writer; additionally requested 16-writer coverage.
hypothesis: Combine a small initial prefix (preserves16writer startup) with complete synchronous extent preparation on subsequent serial demand (matches pre-async preparation frequency). The repeated128KiB serial prototype fails its pre-async latency/throughput guards. Keep async suffix work only with concurrent reservations.
candidate: Add immutable initial_end to the async control. At a readiness miss with zero/one batch operation, use complete existing extent preparation once any prefix beyond initial_end was prepared. For first preparation retain required128KiB prefix, with no background request unless concurrent. Multiple operations retain original asynchronous prefix/suffix work. All preparation shares existing cursor/error state and bounds; no durability/codec/resource changes.
protocol: SSD only, same payload/options/cooldowns/audits and arms. Run one-writer5pairs first. If its required guards fail, stop before unrun high cells and preserve all serial captures. If it passes, run16point,16batch,8point,8batch3pairs each, unchanged source/binary. No score-selected retries or pooling different candidates.
guards: Each cell candidate/async paired raw, v4-normalized and arm-median throughput >=0.95, paired p99<=1.10, identical DATA bytes and paired sync count<=1.05. Serial additionally requires p99 versus async<=0.95 and versus pre-async<=1.10; paired raw versus pre-async>=0.95. CPU reported. These are exploratory fix guards, not complete RFC qualification. Report exact failed guards without overriding the maintainer retention of the original async optimization.
correctness: Full cargo make check,9 focused tests,direct typos and release build outside sandbox. Serial rollover test checks first128KiB readiness with no wake, whole allocated readiness after later serial rollovers, concurrent-to-serial transition with paused old background work, preserved bytes and65exact recovered ACKs. Preserve all failure/cap/sealing tests.
decision: Original async0ff remains kept by maintainer instruction. Commit this separate hybrid scheduling fix only if all fixed five-cell guards pass. If not, keep core and continue from measured failure without deleting captures. No PR/push.
